checks.acceptance: Reads denied and audited; no public object or unrestricted URL.
checks.stimulus: Try unauthenticated and cross-purpose object reads.

checks.acceptance: Independent digest/media probe rejects it before ASR or scoring.
checks.stimulus: Corrupt, truncate or mislabel a committed object.

checks.acceptance: All in-scope objects removed or documented under exact retention exception, with receipts.
checks.stimulus: Delete one test participant lineage including derived outputs and partial uploads.

claim_ceiling: Candidate design record only; no executed check, selected integration, participant-data permission or release.
environment: isolated synthetic object store plus candidate cloud account/region after owner setup
evidence_requirements: attributed pass, fail or inconclusive result for every check
logs or receipts sufficient for independent replay
recorded deviations, adverse effects and unresolved uncertainty
failure_route: Hold media processing and deployment decision until custody failures are resolved.
objective: Prove private storage, integrity, lifecycle and complete deletion for media and derivatives.
rejection_gates: any silent data loss or untraceable score-path change
unresolved differential failure or unsupported mode presented as valid
threshold_registration: Quantitative limits, supported devices, cost ceiling and reviewer acceptance authority must be fixed before a run can support pilot selection.
